name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – After § 23 – Am 27
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 23a. Recalls that Ukrainian sovereignty must also be safeguarded with respect to control over its natural resources, and emphasises that any pressure exerted by transnational companies or foreign governments, such as the United States or the EU, to gain access to these resources is entirely unacceptable;
